notes.sv: Kräver minst sex månaders medlemskap i Sveriges Ingenjörer. Ansökningsperiod 1 december–1 mars; den som studerar ett helt läsår utomlands prioriteras. Besked senast i juni.
notes.en: Requires at least six months' membership in Sveriges Ingenjörer. Application window 1 December–1 March; applicants studying abroad for a full academic year are given preference. Decisions by June.
